summary: The three Brouwerian completeness modules (BrouwerianCompleteness 528, PointedBrouwerianCompleteness 561, MplPointedConservative 658 = 1747 lines) share an ~80% identical Lindenbaum-quotient + order-lemma + truth-lemma + completeness skeleton and differ ONLY in the bot interpretation (top / OrderBot-least / free bot_val) plus one OrderBot-via-efq instance in the pointed tier. The generic HilbertLindenbaum.lean already provides every meet-fragment order lemma parametric over an arbitrary Axioms predicate, using only the five conj-imp witnesses (K,S,andI,andE1,andE2) of the 8-field MinimalAxioms class; the fragments re-derive them only because they lack the three or-axioms MinimalAxioms requires. Recommended fix: introduce a 5-field ConjImpAxioms typeclass (a strict factor of MinimalAxioms), make MinimalAxioms extend it, generalize the meet-fragment Lindenbaum lemmas' bound to [ConjImpAxioms], add one BrouwerianSemilattice instance, host the universal evaluator BrouwerianBotEvaluate in substrate, and recover all three tiers as corollaries that fix bot_val (pointed adds OrderBot via efq). The two bridge equalities BrouwerianEvaluate = BrouwerianBotEvaluate(.)(top) and PointedBrouwerianEvaluate = BrouwerianBotEvaluate(.)(bot) hold by trivial induction. Only 8 public names are externally referenced; all Lindenbaum internals are private and freely collapsible. Net ~ -1000 lines, no new axioms, no sorry.
